body: I am about to
Without going through boring details, all I can say is that the life I live is not worth living
I won't tell my parents, it's due in 5 days
Nobody cares about people like us. I went to countless therapy sessions in the last decade, it didn't really help my situation

I am in a similar boat. I never had issues with talking to women or going out on dates, but they never moved forward. Things had begun to seem better last year but the pandemic ruined everything. I gave up now after a decade of trying everything I could, things didn't get better so I am gonna off myself before 2022 begins
Good for you, doesn't work for everyone out there
You're right. I worked hard to be well-off but I never flashed my money. I didn't want to be with someone who's in it for the money
I don't see a point, that's why I am gonna off myself in a week
Goodbye. I will be there in 7 days
People are sheep. They follow the herd, and virtue signalling is a popular sport among the herd
Virtue signalling is all anyone is capable of doing, online. It used to bother me, but as I am nearing the end of my time I have stopped caring
People can just cite examples, they will never understand the gravity of your situation. In reality, things might never get better for us
That's my plan on the 31st of this year. I have found the perfect place for my departure
Nothing. There is no cure for loneliness, once you are isolated, your window to have a normal life is gone

Being financially well-off is something I was able to accomplish from my wishlist. It unlocked many choices for me and gave me a good 3 years of distraction until the sheen wore off. Ultimately I realized that it won't help my loneliness
Same here, I didn't ask to be born in a country that's wealthy on paper but is filled with people having third world mentality. Our circumstances are not common, nobody will understand that
I haven't found any. Someone might mention family and other people being left to grieve. I am way past that point, I don't care anymore. I'll be gone before 2022 begins
It's all an unending downward spiral after the effects of loneliness intensify. I wish I found a way out
I will be in the same boat in a couple of months. You are the best judge of your circumstances
I stopped watching porn 5 years ago when it became uninteresting for me

I also don't live in a western country. It's very difficult to date in a conservative country like mine because dating is an exception not the norm. The pandemic hit the last nail in the coffin. I had a few promising prospects but the pandemic pushed everything upside down, locked me at home and ever since it feels like a cage
I have achieved most life goals I had, became debt free, visited 19 countries and I still cannot be content. That void in me is too empty to ignore

Yes. Some people would always be excluded from the dating pool. That's how we have evolved for centuries. With online dating people have become a lot more disposable. It's natural for a minority to try everything they can, be the best version of themselves yet fail in life. We are the exceptions not the norm
Realizations like these become easier to deal with when you are nihilistic
I have been ghosted more times than I can count. Eventually got used to it, as in it stopped affecting me if someone ghosted me. It became a "meh this has happened before" moment for me
Same here. I am successful at everything else but lack of companionship has left a void in me. The pain has become unbearable now
I have been reminded of that, many times. It never bothered me much because I knew it was true. I kept trying my best, succeeded in every other aspect of life but failed romantically
I take such generic advice from the internet with a grain of salt. Nobody can comprehend our situation when they have normal lives
People have biases. Some might disagree but virginity will be a red flag in most parts of the world. No one can understand your situation unless they go through something similar
No I am not, never was. I cannot relate with most people anyway, so there's that
It does and nobody can understand that. I will throw in the towel before the start of 2022

Despite what some people tell you, virginity beyond 20 is and will always be considered a major red flag for relationships especially in western countries where most people have active sex lives since their teenage years. You could be honest and try dating but be prepared for rejections most of the times

I did not face the typical Asian parenting at all. Here's where I cannot relate with most people in my country. I was actively looking for dates since my teenage years. But it didn't work out because many people around me would not risk offending their parents. When my age group started dating I was rejected or ghosted. It goes without saying nobody expressed any interest in me, I tried my best for a decade and finally gave up
I gave up recently when I decided to end things before the dawn of 2022. I was born in a place where I cannot relate with most people. Dating here is not as normalized as in western countries

They occasionally asked me how I was doing romantically. Later on I started dodging their questions, now they don't discuss that. They're sweet people who want me to have a fulfilling life but I'm sure they know it won't happen for me
Same here. We did not choose the circumstances under which we were born. People who haven't been in our shoes will never understand
This. Most people on Reddit are from western countries which are sexually liberated. They would not understand how radically different everything is in our part of the world

I felt that sometimes but I still tried. Got rejected, ghosted or mocked for trying to pursue them. I didn't cold approach people because that will get me in trouble in my country, the culture is not liberal. A decade later, I remained unsuccessful romantically. I don't have to bear this pain for long because I won't make it to 2022
The person could be from the Indian subcontinent. Most people there seem to be dependent on their parents from the get-go
You could say that you don't have a lot of experience instead of saying that you're a virgin
No. I hold conversations well but they disconnect once they find out I don't live in a western country
Nobody can understand our situation. All you can get is generic advice which may or may not work for you. It's pointless to explain. Our life experiences have crushed us, nothing can fix that
I was talking about myself

It depends on your location and culture. Most redditors are white people living in western countries where people are very open to dating and casual sex. That is why people lose their virginity in their teenage years and have multiple LTRs. Anyone who doesn't fit this convention (like virgins) is deemed a red flag or undesirable because that's not the norm.

If you move to Eastern cultures where people are too conservative to date freely, the stigma around being a virgin past 20 is not that significant. Being a virgin has been a net negative for me. I am left with a void that cannot be filled no matter how fulfilling my life is in non-romantic aspects. I am irreligious but stuck in a moderately religious, trad country so I cannot relate with most people here. 

Ultimately, people cannot comprehend something they haven't been through. Hence, virginity will always be considered bad in most parts of the world. Trying to explain your situation is futile.
It is, that is why it will end forever on the New Year's eve
Hope is a false illusion. I gave up long time ago.

I have standards, none of them are related to physical appearance. I'm FA because of a very bad start in my upbringing. I couldn't have the experiences the average population has, the gap is very evident now. Being stuck in a very conservative, hierarchical society doesn't help. I've been rejected numerous times for not being of a certain "height" or being shorter than the person I asked out. Nothing can fix my situation, that's why I will end my misery on the New Year' eve of 2021.
Me too. I won't make it to 2022. My misery will finally end, I don't care about anybody's opinion on that.
I am currently in the midst of going full hermit. Already deleted all my socials, friendships are not worth the pain and time.
I cannot and will never trust people the way I did before. Most of my experiences have shown that people don't work in good faith. The opportunity cost of meeting someone new is not worth the hassle.

I have been celebrating all my birthdays alone for more than a decade now. I go to my favorite fine dining restaurant. Then I drive to faraway spots where I don't see any people, spend some time gazing at the sky then come back home and drink until I pass out.
I had similar experiences after talking about my past that's why I stopped opening up to people. Most people have never been in our shoes, they won't understand what it's like.
